summary: Player sentiment is generally positive, with many users praising the career mode, casual fun with friends, and authentic gameplay. However, negative feedback frequently points out technical issues, poor PC optimization, launcher problems, and frustrating balance or scripting mechanics.

positive: Got around 600 hours in FIFA 24 and honestly still enjoy it. I don’t buy FIFA every year, usually I wait 2–3 years so the next game actually feels different and the changes are worth it. Compared to FC 26, 24 still feels really good to play and I’ve had way more fun with it than I expected after all these hours. I’ll see how FC 27 turns out and might finally switch this year, but for now FIFA 24 is still a solid game and definitely got my money’s worth.

EA SPORTS FC™ 24 succeeds by doubling down on what matters most: authentic gameplay and player identity. It feels like the start of a bright, innovative future for football gaming. If you love the sport, there is simply no better way to get onto the pitch and start writing your own legacy.
Even though it's the same game every year, it's the best football game out there.
Fun to play and chill with friends. Career mode and manager mode are very fun

This game is genuinely a fun game if you play it casually, whether that's with your firends or just by yourself. However, the experience changes drastically at a competitive level as the game is scripted, making skill fell less important than it should. Either way still recommend the game
